title: VTA Notifications — shared definitions
description: Shared shapes for the notifications a VTA holds for its principal: each a notifications/notify notification the VTA accepted for a DID it holds keys of, directly or by notifications/relay, filed in the trust context that DID belongs to (VTI-NTF-050). A VTA holds at most one record per originator and notificationId, replaced by a higher revision (VTI-NTF-022). Its principal's client lists them with vta/notifications/list, reads one whole with vta/notifications/show, and dismisses one with vta/notifications/dismiss. Holding a notification tells nobody anything: the VTA sends nothing to the originator, a relayer or the thing's holder because of it, and opens the thing only at the principal's choice (VTI-NTF-053).

RecordId.title: RecordId
RecordId.description: The VTA's own identifier for one held notification, stable across the revisions that replace it. Opaque and compared for equality only; unguessable, because a show of a record in a context the caller may not read is refused and an enumerable identifier would turn the refusal into an oracle.

ContextId.title: ContextId
ContextId.description: The trust context the notification is held in: the one the addressed DID belongs to.

State.title: State
State.description: The principal's disposition of a held notification: `active`, or `dismissed` by vta/notifications/dismiss. Dismissal is the principal's alone and changes nothing outside the VTA (VTI-NTF-052).

HeldNotification.title: HeldNotification
HeldNotification.description: One notification the VTA holds, as a client with standing in its context sees it. `originator` and every entry of `relayedBy` were verified by the VTA when it accepted the notification (VTI-NTF-042); a client that does not take the VTA's word for them reads the document with vta/notifications/show and verifies it itself.

addressee.description: The principal's DID the notification, or the relay that delivered it, was addressed to.

originator.description: The issuer of the notifications/notify document: who said the thing exists.

relayedBy.description: The relayers the held revision passed through, in the order they relayed it: the first is the notification's own addressee, the last the relayer that delivered it to `addressee`. Empty for a notification the originator sent to `addressee` directly. The acceptance policy counted the last one (VTI-NTF-031).

notification.description: The notification's members at the revision held.

receivedAt.description: When the VTA accepted the revision held.

dismissedAt.description: When the principal dismissed it. Present exactly when `state` is `dismissed`.
